title: 第10章 寒门第一胜第9章 问剑初试
lines: 台不高，青石铺成，四角插着黑旗，旗面上写着“初试”两个字。
沈照夜走上去时，台下已经围了一圈人。
裴岳站在三号台另一侧，年纪比裴安大些，脸上没什么笑。他不是裴家主脉，却穿着裴家旁支的赤纹袖，腰间佩着一柄青钢剑。
要往上爬，就得替主脉把事做干净。
裴岳看着沈照夜，先开口：
沈照夜的眼神平静下来。
他怕的是有人只敢在背后动她。
药铺管事从人群后走出来，手里捧着一本账册。
沈照夜看见那本账册，眸色微冷。
韩松站在裁判席旁，像早就知道这一幕。
裴岳朗声道：“今日第一轮，我若胜，沈照夜自愿退出问剑初试，交还暂留资格。沈照夜若胜，药铺恢复沈霜基础药供，直到初试结束。”
周野骂道：“拿人妹妹的药逼战？”
沈霜站在人群后，脸色发白。
韩松开口：“问剑台上，不许私设赌约。”
“韩执事，这不是赌约。沈照夜药债未清，本就该影响资格。我只是给他一个争回来的机会。”
药铺管事立刻接话：“若沈照夜胜，药铺可按旧例供给基础药，不再额外赊寒露丹。”
裴岳敢当众说，韩松若不认，反而像剑院怕一个凡骨赢。
片刻后，韩松道：“若双方自愿，可记入本场附约。只限基础药供，不涉旧账。”
content_en:
Platform No. 3 is on the west side of Wenjian Platform.
The platform is not high and is paved with bluestone. There are black flags at the four corners, with the words "Preliminary Test" written on the flag.
When Shen Zhaoye walked up, there was already a circle of people in the audience.
Someone looked at him.
Someone looked at Teruya behind him.
More people are looking at the Pei family.
Pei Yue stood on the other side of stage 3. He was older than Pei An and had no smile on his face. He is not the main lineage of the Pei family, but he wears the red-striped sleeves of the Pei family branch and wears a green steel sword on his waist.
The side branch disciples know one thing best.
If you want to climb up, you have to do things for the main line.
Pei Yue looked at Shen Zhaoye and spoke first:
"I heard that your sister still owes money for her medicine."
The voices in the audience dropped.
Shen Zhaoye's eyes calmed down.
He is not afraid of others mentioning Shen Shuang.
What he was afraid of was that someone would only dare to touch her behind her back.
"Is it related to you?"
Pei Yue raised his hand.
The drug store manager walked out from behind the crowd, holding an account book in his hand.
Shen Zhaoye's eyes turned cold when he saw the account book.
Han Song stood next to the referee's bench, as if he had known this scene for a long time.
Pei Yue said loudly: "Today's first round, if I win, Shen Zhaoye will voluntarily withdraw from the preliminary test of sword asking and return his temporary qualification. If Shen Zhaoye wins, the drug store will resume Shen Shuang's basic medicine supply until the end of the preliminary test."
The audience was in an uproar.
Zhou Ye scolded: "Take my sister's medicine to force me to fight?"
Pei An smiled and said, "Why, you don't dare to pick it up?"
Shen Shuang stood behind the crowd, her face turned pale.
Han Song said: "No private bets are allowed on the Sword Asking Stage."
Pei Yue handed over his hand.
"Deacon Han, this is not a bet. Shen Zhaoye's unpaid drug debt should have affected his qualifications. I just gave him a chance to get his money back."
The manager of the drug store immediately answered: "If Shen Zhaoye wins, the drug store can provide basic medicines as usual and will not provide additional Cold Dew Pills on credit."
Basic medicine.
It's not about clearing old accounts.
But it was enough for Shen Shuang to survive the first test.
Shen Zhaoye looked at Han Song.
"Do you admit it, Deacon Han?"
Han Song was silent.
Everyone in the audience is watching.
Pei Yue dared to say it in public, and if Han Song refused to admit it, he would be like the Sword Academy who was afraid that a mortal would win.
After a while, Han Song said: "If both parties are willing, it can be recorded in the addendum of this site. It is only for basic medicine supply, and no old debts will be involved."
Pei Yue smiled.
"Shen Zhaoye, do you dare?"
Shen Zhaoye didn't look at Pei Yue.
He looked at the drug store manager.
"Write it into the account book."
The manager of the drug store was startled.
